name: WORLD_CORE_V06_PACKAGE_CONTINUATION

continuation_rule.condition: The immediately preceding V06 step has an immutable implementation commit, complete evidence with applicable automated checks passing, no invalidating upstream finding, and status IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED or VERIFIED.
continuation_rule.effect: The immediately following V06 step may start on codex/world-core-v06-v10 without claiming verification.
continuation_rule.dependency_exception: An IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED dependency is accepted only between adjacent members of the exact allowed_steps sequence.

preserved_controls: V06.1, V06.2 and V06.3 remain IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED unless independently promoted
normal engineering acceptance, determinism, exactness, architecture, environment, security and governance checks remain mandatory
a blocking upstream review finding stops affected downstream work
ADR-01 and ADR-03 remain the approved V06 decision authority
no database or production mutation without separate exact-step authority
V06 package review and reconciliation remain mandatory before V07
prohibitions: merge to main before package review and merge authority
